answer: EigenTrust-style centrality is computed from normalized, reciprocity-weighted trust links, then decayed with an exponential half-life: reputation fades unless honest service is sustained. A newly created identity—whether labeled sparrow, opal, or nebula—has almost no trusted incoming paths, so its eigenvector centrality remains near zero. Sybils therefore cannot manufacture consensus influence merely by multiplying identities; they must first earn durable, reciprocal trust.
